diagnosis.cause: The runner replaced absent PGSERVICE and PGSERVICEFILE with empty strings. On POSIX, libpq interprets both as configured values and fails while opening the empty service-file path before connecting to the explicitly selected owned database.

windows_masking.interpretation: On this Windows runtime, assigning an empty value leaves the Python mapping key but removes the CRT variable. Linux libpq reads an actual empty native value.
